name: Karada o Uru Seifuku Joshi Namahame Nakadashi -T* L*ve-ru!-
original_name: カラダを売る制服女子ナマハメ中出し -T●L●veる!-
source:
Life was a monotonous loop of work and home.
I had no girlfriend or particular talents. My interest, if you call it that, was playing casual games on my phone.
I was playing one of those games when a new banner popped up. I was somehow excited.
I tapped the icon and registered my information.

A few days later, I was "chat mates" with a growing list of girls.
I smiled as my eyes crawled over the cute photos on my friend list.
When I tested the rules by asking one girl on a real life date, she readily agreed.

With a touch of concern about how easy this was, and a throbbing chest and groin, I met her. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120648.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
生活是工作和家庭的单调循环。
我没有女朋友，也没有特殊的才能。我的兴趣，如果你这么说的话，是在手机上玩休闲游戏。
当我正在玩其中一款游戏时，出现了一个新的横幅。我有点兴奋。
我点击了图标并注册了我的信息。

几天后，我和越来越多的女孩成为“聊天伙伴”。
当我的眼睛爬过朋友列表上可爱的照片时，我笑了。
当我通过邀请一位女孩进行现实生活中的约会来测试规则时，她欣然同意了。

怀着对这太容易的担忧，以及胸部和腹股沟的悸动，我见到了她。
